laws.identity: mapping proposition identity is derived from exact typed endpoint coordinates relation content relation kind relation version and direction law, never source path row role or witness
laws.occurrence: a source profile row and its exact left and right field and value identities form a separately addressable mapping witness occurrence
laws.closure: resolved requires both exact endpoints present; unresolved and retired endpoints remain explicit dispositions and cannot be promoted by a mapping witness
laws.symmetry: symmetric endpoint order canonicalizes only proposition identity; directed endpoint order remains semantic
laws.evidence: multiple source occurrences may witness one proposition without multiplying independent support; dependence lineage remains separately required
laws.bulk: the whole mapping boundary resolves in one canonical native batch with deterministic order-preserving records and a semantic receipt
